name: Code
summary: A short piece of code inside a sentence. For a block of code use CodeBlock.

a11y.apg: A native code element. No interaction. For a multi-line block with copy and highlighting, CodeBlock.

props.name: color
props.description: Two colours only, like the reference library: the text colour or the muted one. A closed list protects contrast — both pass AA on every Aurea surface.

props.name: tone
props.description: The text colour with the native package's name — the same names on web and native. link is for a real link only: the text colour with the yellow highlighter behind it on the light theme, the yellow underlined on the dark one — both say "tap here". For emphasis that is not a link, use primary: the text colour on the light theme, where the yellow is never text, and the yellow on the dark one, with nothing under it. The state colours are the -400 pair. It wins over color when both are given.

props.name: weight
props.description: Overrides the weight of the role. Headings are semibold and body text is regular by default. "extrabold" (800, --weight-extrabold) is for a cover title; the default title weight is still semibold.

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment. start and end follow the writing direction, so the same value mirrors in RTL.

props.name: truncate
props.description: One line, cut with an ellipsis. Turns the element into a block so the cut has a width to measure against.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Value figures: on the web, the code font (IBM Plex Mono, ADR-0077) with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) — for values and identifiers that line up in a column (price, year, contract number) or change on screen. Off by default: in running text the narrow "1" is right. Native: the same prop sets fontVariant ["tabular-nums"]; the native font change comes with the native typeface files.
